title: brassica rapa subvar. pe-tsai
intro: Brassica rapa subvar. pe-tsai, commonly known as Chinese broccoli or gai lan, is a cruciferous vegetable that belongs to the Brassica family. It is rich in vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants, providing numerous health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Chinese broccoli include its potential to have anti-cancer and anti-inflammatory effects, as well as its ability to support bone health and digestive function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, isothiocyanates, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
